headword: {国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}

definitions.explanation: Mail sent to or received from another country. Covers letters, parcels, and other postal items crossing international borders.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}で{送|おく}る。
{国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}は{届|とど}くまで1{週間|しゅうかん}かかる。
examples.english: International mail takes about a week to arrive.

examples.japanese: {郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}で{国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}の{料金|りょうきん}を{聞|き}いた。
examples.english: I asked about international mail rates at the post office.

notes:
A compound of {国際|こくさい} (international) and {郵便|ゆうびん} (mail/postal service). Japan Post offers several international mail services with varying speeds and prices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}で{送|おく}る: to send by international mail
- {国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}の{料金|りょうきん}: international postage rates
- {国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}{小包|こづつみ}: international parcel

TYPES OF INTERNATIONAL MAIL:
- EMS ({国際|こくさい}スピード{郵便|ゆうびん}): Express Mail Service — the fastest option
- {航空便|こうくうびん}: airmail — standard international airmail
- {船便|ふなびん}: surface mail / sea mail — cheapest but slowest
- SAL{便|びん}: economy airmail — between airmail and surface mail in speed and price

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国内|こくない}{郵便|ゆうびん}: domestic mail — mail within Japan
